text:
maya: Quick idea — move the weekly triage from Fri 11am -> Tue 9am (PST). Better overlap with APAC support and earlier in the week to catch regressions. Thoughts?

sam: +1 on earlier in the week. Fridays feel packed for release prep. Tue 9am works for me. :thumbsup:

jordan: Might be better. Can we trim the agenda to 15m? Last week ran 30 and people started dropping.

lee: Agree on 15m. Suggest this micro-agenda: 
```
Agenda (15m):
- 3m quick rollup (new P0/P1 bugs)
- 5m owner swaps & assignments
- 4m regressions / customer blockers
- 3m follow-ups + action items
```

maya: Nice. Also propose adding a simple "blocking_customer" tag in the bug title so we can scan quickly (prefix [BLOCKER]). Saves time.

alexa: Can we automate a weekly owner rotation? I can update the calendar invite and add a Google Sheet with the rotation table.

oncall-bot: Deploy reminder: Weekly triage scheduled change detected. Please confirm before calendar update.

sam: @alexa if you add the sheet, I'll take the first week of rotation.

jordan: I'll take week 2. @lee can you cover week 3?

lee: Yep, I can do week 3. Also let's set a hard 15m timebox and record action items as GH issues prefixed "triage/". Short link in the meeting notes.

maya: Agreement checklist: 
- Move meeting to Tue 9am (PST) — pending calendar update
- Agenda template (15m) — approved
- Blocking flag prefix [BLOCKER] — approved
- Rotation sheet — @alexa to create
- Action item convention: GH issues "triage/<short-title>" — approved

alexa: I'll create the rotation sheet and update the invite by EOD today. I'll also add a small reminder blurb in the event description about the [BLOCKER] prefix and GH issue convention.

sam: One more small ask: can we add a short weekly metric line to the invite notes — e.g., open P0s, avg time to ack. 1-liner so we don't dig into dashboards during the call.

maya: Good call. We'll add an owner to populate that: @sam will paste a 1-line metric in the event before the meeting.

jordan: Sounds clean. Experiment for 4 weeks? If we like it we keep it. If not, revert. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maya: Experiment 4 weeks. I'll ping the wider eng list for any objections, then @alexa please update calendar if no objections by EOD.

oncall-bot: Note: If a meeting moves, update oncall rota if it conflicts.

lee: No conflicts on my side. Thanks all.

alexa: Calendar updated to Tue 9am PST for the next 4 weeks — invite sent. Rotation sheet: https://docs.google.com/example (placeholder).

sam: Got the invite. Thanks!

maya: Closing thread — thanks everyone. We'll evaluate after 4 runs and share notes in #eng.
